meta.name: It Happened In Calcutta Hindi 720p
meta.description:
A story that managed to leave a mark during the times of war, epidemic and political unrest. Based in the era of 60s and 70s, Ronobir and Kusum's story not only created memories, but also impacted history.

videos.title: Summer of 62
videos.overview: Kusum is excited for her first day at college, catches up with some of her old friends. Enter Ronobir Chatterjee, the harbinger of mishappenings. Kusum tries avoiding him for her own good.
